gating: Run layers in order. Do not run a layer until every case in the layer before it passes.

unit.case: load() returns false when JSON.parse throws and shows #empty
servedInit sets #live textContent to offline (not live) when load fails or fetch throws
empty drop title is h1 Open a feature plan
in-card section labels are h2 (not h3); page title stays h1
template===planted still holds after empty/heading edits
journey diameters stay 27/32/37/42/47 and are not grown to 44
Technical details details element has data-region tech-details
template===planted still holds after journey/tech edits

ui.case: empty state: badge offline, h1 empty title, wrapping path, 44px file control
ui.why_ui: Rendered empty-drop layout and badge paint only exist in the browser; static CSS cannot prove the empty state at phone width. Compare prototype state empty vs live viewer.

ui.case: journey state: seven dots fit at 320 with no document sideways scroll
ui.why_ui: scrollWidth===clientWidth is a layout outcome; unit can only assert min-width 4px in source. Compare prototype state journey vs live.

ui.case: open state: Technical details summary hit box is at least 44px tall
ui.why_ui: Rendered summary height depends on padding plus line-box; only the browser proves ≥44px. Compare prototype state open vs live.

not_tested: HTTP API, DB, and role matrices — none in this package (api layer empty).
Browser Playwright e2e suite — no new dependencies; UI cases are satisfied by the checkpoint ui gate (prototype states empty/journey/open vs planted viewer.html), not a new e2e runner.
Runtime fetch against a live HTTP server — offline/load contracts are proven by static assertions on the template source (U1–U2).
